critical_code_review_comments: HumanVerification.jsx: 'aria-label' announces the code (e.g., 'Verification code 8 X M L 2') which trivially defeats the captcha for screen-reader-based bots. Consider removing/obfuscating the aria-label for adversarial contexts.

The visual captcha is only line-through wavy text on plain HTML — trivially machine-readable via DOM scraping (as demonstrated in this test). Consider server-side canvas image rendering if bot pressure is real.
